description: This file declares the H264VaapiVideoEncoderDelegate class, which provides H264 encoding functionality using VAAPI, including stream header generation, encoder state management, and reference frame handling. It defines related data structures, methods, and internal state variables.

classes.name: H264VaapiVideoEncoderDelegate
classes.description: A class implementing H264 encoding via VAAPI, managing encoding parameters, SPS/PPS generation, and frame submission.

classes.name: EncodeParams
classes.description: A struct holding encoding parameters such as bitrate, framerate, QP values, and reference frame limits.

classes.name: TemporalLayers
classes.description: A nested class likely related to managing temporal layering in encoding (details not provided).

methods.name: H264VaapiVideoEncoderDelegate
methods.description: Constructor initializing the encoder delegate with VAAPI wrapper and error callback.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the encoder with configuration parameters.

methods.name: GetCodedSize
methods.description: Returns the current coded size of the video.

methods.name: GetMaxNumOfRefFrames
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of reference frames.

methods.name: GetSVCLayerResolutions
methods.description: Returns resolutions for scalable video coding layers.

methods.name: PrepareEncodeJob
methods.description: Prepares an encode job for execution.

methods.name: GetMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a given encode job.

methods.name: UpdateSPS
methods.description: Updates the current SPS (Sequence Parameter Set).

methods.description: Updates the current PPS (Picture Parameter Set).
